_comment: Every feature two phones share, and the two-parent test that covers it (tools/check-e2e-coverage.js). 'e2e' names classes or Class#method in app/src/androidTest/java/com/coparently/app/e2e/; 'exempt' says why no emulator run can cover it and what does instead. A new collection, storage prefix, push type or callable fails the invariants job until it has an entry here.

google_oauth.exempt: Server-only (closed to every client) and needs a real Google OAuth exchange; functions/test covers the hash check, firestore-tests the closed rule.

calendar_feeds.exempt: Closed to every client; the callables that write it are listed under functions.

export_receipts.exempt: Closed to every client; the callables that write it are listed under functions.

exchangeGoogleAuthCode.exempt: Needs a real Google authorization code; functions/test covers the exchange and the refresh-token hash.

refreshGoogleAccessToken.exempt: Needs a real Google refresh token; functions/test covers the oracle check.

backfillRecordFamilyIds.exempt: Operator-only maintenance callable, not a phone-to-phone feature; functions/test covers it.

backfillFamilyDocuments.exempt: Operator-only maintenance callable, not a phone-to-phone feature; functions/test covers it.

backfillParentSlots.exempt: Operator-only maintenance callable, not a phone-to-phone feature; functions/test covers it.
